text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
What a shame~
Still, please don't let it get you down too much.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Yes... is what I'd like to say,
but it's already time for me to head home.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: "Let us not forget this bitter taste of defeat and challenge it again someday."
It ended in a disappointing result...
